title: CPS Honors 299 Framework Project
excerpt: This is a quick blog post about the Creativity Framework Project.
content:
One thing that the 4P's of creativity framework can be applied to is my own personal game development.
 From the Product perspective, this game is designed to be engaging and fun for players. 
From the Process perspective, the development process involves iterative design and testing. 
From the Person perspective, this game is based on an idea I had going on a myth that I remembered reading about recently. Because this project is not very large or well developed yet, the Press section is not very relevant, except that during college it is more difficult to find the time to keep working on this game. 
The final result will be a demo of my game or the fully released game, for the Product P of the framework.
